title: Why Do Cows Chew Twice?
narration: This 3D Short is only about this: Why Do Cows Chew Twice.
A cow swallows, then brings it back to chew again.
Let me show you that in 3D.
That extra chew helps bacteria break it down.
Watch this next bit closely. This is why it happens.
The second chew is called chewing the cud.
So the idea is simple: cause, then effect.
The pictures today are a new animal world. Not yesterday's film.
That is the whole idea, in one short 3D film.
Stay to the end. The last shot is the takeaway for why do cows chew twice.
If a grown-up is with you, pause and tell them the cause in one sentence.
Tomorrow a brand new 3D film. Same curious science. Brand new pictures.
